erflow (blocker 2):** fixed in `app/src/design/Slider.tsx`. At 375px the pills now wrap onto two rows (6 then 5), so every value from 0 to 10 is visible and tappable with no sideways scroll. Each pill is still at least 44×44px, as the touch-target rule requires. On wider screens they sit in one row. This differs from the mockup, which fits one row by making the pills 28px wide. That's below 44px, so I kept the touch-target rule over the mockup.
- **Badge stretching (major):** fixed in `app/src/design/IndicatorLabel.tsx`. The badge now sizes to its text, so it stays a compact pill inside cards.

I logged the App Shell scope conflict in `.harness/inbox/questions.jsonl` and the two-row layout in `.harness/inbox/risks.jsonl`. No protected tests were touched.

Lint, typecheck, format check, unit tests (86) and e2e (8) all pass. I had to run `yarn install` first because the worktree had no dependencies. I didn't run the `@visual` screenshot tests, so nobody has looked at the two-row layout in a screenshot yet.
